issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: stone_brick_wall, red_banner.
Only 46 blocks: too bare for a common (at least 50). Carlton wants more detail, not less.

notes.artefacts: the wall torch at (1,6,1) facing south hangs on the red banner at (1,6,0); a banner can't hold a torch, so in game it pops off when placed
notes.detail: Adds only 4 blocks: banner in the corner crenel, lantern post, torch.

visual.summary: L1 plus a red standing banner in the corner crenel, a lantern on a wall post at the inner corner of the walk and a wall torch.
problems: Wall torch at (1,6,1) [facing=south] is unsupported: the block north of it, (1,6,0), is the red banner. Attach it to a merlon instead, e.g. at (2,6,1) facing south against merlon (2,6,0).
Lantern post (stone_brick_wall at (2,5,2) + lantern (2,6,2)) sits on the walk and narrows the turning walk to 1 block at the corner; consider moving it to the outer edge or onto a merlon.

Open ends match the straight profile (footing stair y0, wall z1-2/x1-2, corbel stair y4, parapet y5, walk standing at y5, merlons at even positions), so it joins cleanly. Note for the whole wall set, not this piece: odd-length modules with merlons at both ends put two merlons side by side at every joint (corner x2 next to straight x0, same as straight x4 next to straight x0).
